notes.title: ⚔️ The Tales of Klodan Demo is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
We’ve been eagerly waiting for this moment, and we’re thrilled to finally share our demo with you.

In this first glimpse into the world of Klodan, you’ll uncover the beginning of a story filled with mystery, choices, and adventure. It’s just the start — a small peek behind the curtain of what lies ahead.

Immerse yourself in the atmosphere, meet key characters, and make your first choices that will shape your path forward.

💬 We’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback!

➤ Play now and become part of the story!

notes.title: Our Steam Page is Live!
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!

We are thrilled to announce that our game’s Steam page is finally live! 🎉 We’re incredibly excited to welcome you all to our world and share this journey with you.

The first chapter of the game is set to release in Spring 2025, and we can’t wait for you to experience it. In the meantime, we’d love for you to add the game to your wishlist—it helps us out a lot and ensures you won’t miss any important updates!

Stay tuned for more news, behind-the-scenes content, and surprises along the way.

Thank you for your support, and welcome aboard! 💙
